caption:
ChatGPT Business Hub checklist: 4 things small business owners should fix before claiming their listing inside ChatGPT.

On November 10, 2026, OpenAI opened Business Hub in beta. Local stores and restaurants in the United States can now claim their existing listing in ChatGPT, update hours, description, category and products, and see how often ChatGPT mentions them and how many website clicks it sends. Claiming takes a phone, email or website check, then an identity check.

Before you claim yours:
1. Write down your exact business name, address and hours, and use them everywhere.
2. Pick the one category that says what you do.
3. Write a two sentence description a stranger would understand.
4. Make sure your website shows the same hours, services and contact details.

BrightLocal, a local search company, reports AI tools went from 6% to 45% as a source of local recommendations. Customers are asking. Make sure ChatGPT has the right answer.

At Blackwell Graphics we build the branding, logo and website that Black-owned businesses need to show up clearly, in ChatGPT and everywhere else. DM us "CLAIM" to talk it through, or visit blackwellgraphics.com (link in bio).
